full_name: Victorian Institute of Sport Assessment - Patella
description: A self-administered questionnaire designed to assess severity of patellar tendinopathy. The VISA-P is both a measure of severity and ability to undertake sports.
instructions: Please answer every question. Only circle ONE response for each question.

sections.title: Patellar Tendon Symptoms and Function
sections.description: For these questions, please answer each question by placing a mark on the line.

questions.question: For how many minutes can you sit pain-free?
Do you have pain walking downstairs with a normal gait cycle?
Do you have pain during or immediately after doing 10 (single leg) squats?
Do you have pain immediately after doing 10 (single leg) squats?
Do you have pain during full weight bearing through your affected knee? (kneeling)
Do you have pain during hopping? (circle one number only)
Are you currently undertaking sport or other physical activity?

options.label: Full training ± competition but not at same level as when symptoms began
Competing at the same or higher level as when symptoms began

questions.question: Please complete EITHER A, B or C in this question. If you have no pain while undertaking patellar tendon loading sports, please complete Q8A ONLY. If you have pain while undertaking patellar tendon loading sports but it does not stop you from completing the activity, please complete Q8B ONLY. If you have pain that stops you from completing patellar tendon loading sports, please complete Q8C ONLY.
questions.description: Question 8A: If you have no pain while undertaking patellar tendon loading sports, for how long can you train/practise?
